Soft directional daytime light comes from a large window at the upper left, gentle shadow falloff down her right side. Palette of sixty percent warm grey studio, thirty percent charcoal, ten percent ivory and skin. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, natural skin texture, gentle film grain, restrained naturalistic colour.
